note: Episode queue. status: idea -> scripted (story JSON written + checked) -> rendered (mp4 + thumbs + both Shorts cut) -> uploaded. publish = UTC. Cadence (owner, 11 Nov 2026, replaces the 4-day rhythm of 7 Nov): ONE video a day at most, all at 16:00 UTC (11:00 New York, 16:00 London, 21:00 Pakistan). Day 1 the long episode (30-45 minutes, aim 30-35, built around a hidden person, STYLE.md 1); day 2 Short 1 = the story's opening, cut from the episode; day 3 Short 2 = a special moment from the middle, cut from the episode; day 4 the next episode. Both Shorts are cut and uploaded (scheduled) in the same run as the episode, so no separate Short writing. Trial review on 5 Dec 2026. An episode that isn't ready (pacing passed, sources opened) waits a day rather than going out rushed.
